QF.id: VII Market Participants in Securities Markets_44

question.text: Which entity is the first to have raised capital through issuing Indian Depository Receipts (IDRs)?

explanation.text: The Logic: Standard Chartered Bank is the first entity to have raised capital through issuing Indian Depository Receipts (IDRs). The Trap: The other foreign banks listed have not been recorded in the workbook as the first IDR issuer; the source uses Standard Chartered Bank as the specific example. Note: IDRs are the instrument through which foreign companies can raise capital in India, and Standard Chartered Bank is the workbook's stated first issuer.
